candidate_apis.name: llama_version
candidate_apis.contract: Version string; copy bounded text while DLL remains loaded.
candidate_apis.limits_or_unknowns: Header does not document ownership, nullability or lifetime; do not free the const pointer.

candidate_apis.name: llama_model_default_params
candidate_apis.contract: Returns the exact llama_model_params by value; use declared type, then only prospectively approved overrides.
candidate_apis.limits_or_unknowns: Actual default values and initialization effects are unknown until exact implementation review.

candidate_apis.name: llama_backend_init
candidate_apis.contract: Header says initialize llama+GGML once at program start.
candidate_apis.limits_or_unknowns: Necessary behavior for vocabulary-only loading, backend discovery and device effects remain unverified.

candidate_apis.name: llama_backend_free
candidate_apis.contract: Header says call once at program end; currently describes MPI use.
candidate_apis.limits_or_unknowns: Implementation and required ordering beyond conservative post-model cleanup remain unverified.

candidate_apis.name: llama_model_load_from_file
candidate_apis.contract: Takes const path string and exact params by value; standard split names follow <name>-%05d-of-%05d.gguf.
candidate_apis.limits_or_unknowns: Return failure/null behavior, path encoding, actual split access and vocabulary-only/CPU early-return ordering remain unverified.

candidate_apis.name: llama_model_free
candidate_apis.contract: Release the model through its public API after all vocabulary users/samplers finish.
candidate_apis.limits_or_unknowns: No inferred null-tolerance or private destructor/layout; implementation remains pending.

candidate_apis.name: llama_model_get_vocab

declaration.text: LLAMA_API const struct llama_vocab * llama_model_get_vocab(const struct llama_model * model);

candidate_apis.contract: Returns a const vocabulary pointer; keep its model/DLL alive through all token and sampler operations.
candidate_apis.limits_or_unknowns: Conservative borrowed-lifetime policy; model implementation is needed to confirm ownership details.

candidate_apis.name: llama_vocab_n_tokens

declaration.text: LLAMA_API int32_t llama_vocab_n_tokens(const struct llama_vocab * vocab);

candidate_apis.contract: Returns int32 vocabulary count; validate positive finite protocol bound and enumerate IDs0..n-1.
candidate_apis.limits_or_unknowns: Do not infer the approved model count or allocation feasibility without metadata qualification.

candidate_apis.name: llama_vocab_is_eog

declaration.text: LLAMA_API bool llama_vocab_is_eog(const struct llama_vocab * vocab, llama_token token);

candidate_apis.contract: Query every valid vocabulary ID for EOG membership; header names EOS/EOT as examples.
candidate_apis.limits_or_unknowns: EOG is vocabulary-specific and not exhausted by eos/eot helper IDs.

candidate_apis.name: llama_vocab_eos

declaration.text: LLAMA_API llama_token llama_vocab_eos(const struct llama_vocab * vocab); // end-of-sentence

candidate_apis.contract: Returns the configured end-of-sentence token ID.
candidate_apis.limits_or_unknowns: A hint/control, not complete EOG enumeration; range/absence behavior requires implementation checks.

candidate_apis.contract: Returns the configured end-of-turn token ID.
candidate_apis.limits_or_unknowns: A hint/control, not complete EOG enumeration; range/absence behavior requires implementation checks.

candidate_apis.name: llama_tokenize
candidate_apis.contract: Explicit input byte length and caller token capacity; nonnegative count on success, negative required count on failure, INT32_MIN on overflow. Use add_special=false and parse_special=false for planned byte-roundtrip tests; exact equality must be measured.
candidate_apis.limits_or_unknowns: Reject INT32_MIN before negation; bound signed conversions and allocations. Header does not explicitly qualify null-pointer/zero-capacity sizing calls.

candidate_apis.name: llama_token_to_piece

declaration.text:
LLAMA_API int32_t llama_token_to_piece(
              const struct llama_vocab * vocab,
                           llama_token   token,
                                  char * buf,
                               int32_t   length,
                               int32_t   lstrip,
                                  bool   special);

candidate_apis.contract: Caller buffer and int32 capacity; no null terminator; lstrip=0 preserves leading bytes; special controls special-token rendering.
candidate_apis.limits_or_unknowns: Header does not state negative-sizing/overflow return semantics. Do not borrow llama_detokenize's adjacent contract or issue null-buffer sizing calls before implementation review. Treat pieces as bytes, possibly partial UTF-8.

candidate_apis.name: llama_sampler_init_grammar
candidate_apis.contract: Non-lazy public constructor, grammar_root='root'; reject empty grammar and null return. Native sampler copies grammar/root strings and retains the vocabulary pointer.
candidate_apis.limits_or_unknowns: Empty grammar yields a no-op sampler; non-null initialization is not document/EOG conformance.

candidate_apis.name: llama_sampler_apply

declaration.text: LLAMA_API void                   llama_sampler_apply (      struct llama_sampler * smpl, llama_token_data_array * cur_p);

candidate_apis.contract: Filters caller-owned exact typed candidate array without advancing grammar state; initialize finite logits and inspect allowed/rejected candidate IDs.
candidate_apis.limits_or_unknowns: Generic header permits candidate data-pointer mutation; use exact declarations. Singleton membership is not full-vocabulary cost qualification.

candidate_apis.name: llama_sampler_accept

declaration.text: LLAMA_API void                   llama_sampler_accept(      struct llama_sampler * smpl, llama_token token);

candidate_apis.contract: Advance only after the actual token passed filtering; requires live vocabulary. Never accept rejected EOG.
candidate_apis.limits_or_unknowns: Incomplete-state EOG acceptance calls GGML_ABORT; accepts are not a parser error-return interface. Fresh non-lazy sampler per document avoids trigger/reset ambiguities.

candidate_apis.name: llama_sampler_free

declaration.text: LLAMA_API void                   llama_sampler_free  (      struct llama_sampler * smpl);

candidate_apis.contract: Public free calls sampler-specific cleanup; free each unchained sampler exactly once before model/vocabulary ownership and DLL release.
candidate_apis.limits_or_unknowns: Do not also free a sampler owned by a chain. Native sampler strings/grammar state are cleaned here, vocabulary ownership is not transferred.

bridge_constraints: Use exact headers and decltype(&api) typed GetProcAddress function pointers; no copied layouts/private casts or RVA guesses
Keep approved DLL loaded through all returned pointers, sampler destruction and model cleanup
Fresh nonempty non-lazy grammar sampler for each unchanged document; never accept a filtered-out token or EOG
Tokenize without automatic specials or special/control interpretation; concatenate original token-piece bytes without per-piece UTF-8 decoding, trimming or normalization
Enumerate every vocabulary EOG ID; EOS/EOT helpers alone do not establish completion
Bound input lengths, token counts, piece buffers, signed negative results, vocabulary size, wall time, memory and cleanup prospectively
cleanup_order: release model via llama_model_free after all vocabulary use
backend_free only under source-qualified lifecycle if init was invoked
release native modules after all owned native state and pointers finish
